name: Suture Seam
description: Run a seam of qi down a clean cut and pull its lips together so the wound of an ally or the self shuts.

name: Fresh Warmth
description: Spread bright warmth through a pale limb so colour and feeling come back to an ally or the self.

name: Brisk Gauge
description: Take a quick measure of a patient's wounds and reserves with one pass of the palm.

name: Lesser Veil
description: Draw a short veil of qi in front of a hurt ally to turn aside a glancing blow.

name: Quick Vigour
description: Clasp a spent ally's forearm and pass a bright jolt of vigour into the muscles so the legs hold.

name: Deepwound Mending
description: Send healing qi down into a deep wound and knit it from the bottom upward so an ally or the self stays closed.

name: Purging Rinse
description: Flush grit and the first rot from a dirty wound with clean qi so an ally or the self does not fester.

name: Clean Draw
description: Draw shards of grit up out of a graze on a thread of qi so the skin of an ally lies clean.

name: Grit Rinse
description: Rinse the surface of an open scrape with a sheet of qi so dirt leaves the wound of an ally or the self.

name: Sting Ease
description: Cool the burn of a cleansed wound with a light pass of the palm so the sting of an ally or the self fades.

name: Foulness Sense
description: Hover a hand above a patient and feel for the dull cold that marks a taint in the flesh.

name: Clean Lungs
description: Lend a choking ally clean breath by lacing the air at the mouth with soft qi until the lungs clear.

name: Clean Screen
description: Hold a screen of qi over a cleansed wound so spore and dust cannot settle on the ally beneath.

name: Taint Purge
description: Pull a creeping taint out of the flesh of an ally or the self along a lane of clean qi and let it dissolve.

name: Blood Rinse
description: Wash the blood of an ally or the self clean of a fouling substance by passing it through the healer's steady qi.

name: Fever Quench
description: Pour cool qi into the chest of a feverish ally or the self until the burning dies down.

name: Chill Break
description: Spread slow heat from the belly outward so the shivering of a chilled ally or the self breaks.

name: Sweat Draw
description: Open the skin with a sweep of qi so the sickness heat of an ally or the self leaves with the sweat.

name: Fever Reading
description: Read the heat of a body with a flat palm to tell a passing fever from a deep one.

name: Cool Veil
description: Hang a veil of cool air round a burning patient so the heat of the sickroom cannot press on the ally.

name: Burning Purge
description: Draw the burning taint that rides a sickness out of the blood of an ally or the self and let it scatter.

name: Deep Thaw
description: Melt the frost that has bitten into bone and flesh with a slow wave of heat qi so an ally keeps the limb.

name: Weaving Stitch
description: Cross small stitches of qi over a torn patch of flesh so its frayed edges hold on an ally or the self.

name: Weave Reading
description: Trace the grain of muscle and tendon with qi to see where the weave is torn and where it still holds.

name: Stitch Guard
description: Lay a firm plate of qi over a fresh seam so a knock cannot tear the work of the healer.

name: Tidy Step
description: Shift along a patient's length in short level steps while the hands never lift from the wound.

name: Mending Weave
description: Weave long threads of qi through a torn muscle until it is whole again in an ally or the self.

name: Long Seam
description: Close a wound that runs the length of a limb in one unbroken seam of qi so an ally keeps the arm.

name: Bone Knit
description: Hold the two halves of a cracked bone in a sleeve of qi until they grow back into one in an ally.

name: Sinew Draw
description: Coax a shortened sinew back to its length with warm slow qi so an ally or the self can stretch again.

name: Cartilage Ease
description: Soak a grinding joint in soft qi until the worn cartilage of an ally or the self glides without pain.

name: Marrow Sense
description: Send qi deep into a limb to find a hairline fracture that no hand could feel.

name: Splint Veil
description: Harden a sleeve of qi round a broken limb to serve as a splint that keeps an ally from further harm.

name: Brace Surge
description: Brace a weakened ally's frame from within with a quick surge of qi so the injured body can bear weight.

name: Fracture Mend
description: Draw a clean break back into line and fuse it with dense healing qi so an ally or the self walks again.

name: Tendon Renewal
description: Rebuild a snapped tendon strand by strand with patient qi so the limb of an ally or the self regains its grip.

name: Socket Set
description: Seat a wrenched joint back in its socket with one firm push and a wash of qi that quiets the ligaments of an ally.

name: Venom Sense
description: Taste the blood of a bitten patient through the wrist with qi and name the kind of venom at work.

name: Sting Draw
description: Pull a barb and the swelling round it out of the skin of an ally or the self with a pinch of qi.

name: Bite Close
description: Close a punctured bite with a ring of qi so the wound of an ally or the self stops weeping.

name: Skin Screen
description: Raise a thin screen of qi over the skin of the healer so a patient's tainted blood cannot seep in.

name: Hardy Surge
description: Rouse the body of a poisoned ally with a firm surge of qi so the heart keeps working against the venom.

name: Venom Purge
description: Gather a venom in the blood of an ally or the self into one stream and push it out through the wound.

name: Poison Draw
description: Draw a swallowed poison up from the gut of an ally or the self in a rolling pull of qi before it takes hold.

name: Marrow Tonic
description: Feed the bone marrow of a thin and weak ally with warm qi so the blood runs richer day by day.

name: Appetite Rouse
description: Wake the hunger of a long-sick ally by warming the belly with a touch of qi.

name: Colour Return
description: Coax blood back to a pale face with slow circles of qi at the temples of an ally or the self.

name: Vigour Sense
description: Test how deep the reserve of a worn patient runs before any tonic is poured into it.

name: Cushion Veil
description: Wrap a recovering ally in a cushion of qi that turns away chill and jostling for the length of a rest.

name: Hale Breath
description: Breathe slow rounds of qi into the lungs of a convalescent ally until each breath comes full.

name: Lasting Tonic
description: Lay a slow-releasing tonic of qi into the dantian of an ally so strength comes back steadily for hours.

name: Deep Restoration
description: Rebuild the worn organs of a body ravaged by long sickness with layered qi so an ally or the self recovers.

name: Guarding Palm
description: Hold the free palm out to throw a quick plate of qi between a patient and a strike.

name: Mender's Poise
description: Settle the healer's own stance and breath so the hands stay still while others fight near.

name: Hurried Mend
description: Close the worst of a wound in a single hurried pass so an ally or the self can stand again.

name: Patient Gauge
description: Check a patient's wounds at a glance and a touch to learn which can wait and which cannot.

name: Mending Dome
description: Raise a dome of qi over healer and patient that blunts blows and slowly mends the wounded ally within it.

name: Rapid Cleanse
description: Scour a fresh taint from the wound of an ally or the self in one stroke before it can spread.
